title: Educational, Interesting, Historical Tour With Delicious Food and Drinks
text: This tour was more than I expected.  The tour guide, Pedro, was very knowledgeable and shared intricate and knowledge about Spain and Seville's history, culture, food, society, etc.  I appreciated that it was a personal tour where I could ask questions and learn so many surprising and unusual things, see so many places, and tastes different foods and drinks!  One of the best tours around!
author: Curiosity519099
